title: Timeline year silently dropped whenever a tile is in flight: page.tsx global-state effect guards on isStyleLoaded() and never retries
detail: The effect that pushes timeline.yearFilter into MapLibre is `if (!map.isStyleLoaded()) return; map.setGlobalStateProperty('currentYear', yearFilter)` keyed only on [timeline.yearFilter]. In MapLibre 5.21.0, `isStyleLoaded()` returns `Style.loaded()`, which is false whenever ANY tileManager has a tile not yet loaded/errored or the imageManager is busy -- i.e. transiently after every pan/zoom and for the whole 14-40 s initial attach window the 2026-08-22 audit measured. But `setGlobalStateProperty` only throws when `!style._loaded` (style JSON not parsed), a condition that cannot occur after the map's `load` event. The guard is therefore far stricter than the failure it protects against, and because the effect only re-runs on a year change, a dropped tick is never retried: the bar shows year N while the GPU expressions still evaluate year N-1 (or 1950, the onLoad default at CanopyMap.tsx:84). Reproduce: enable the timeline while forest-age raster/vector tiles are loading, scrub the slider -- the bar moves, the map does not, and the render-gate (waitForRender -> 'idle') resolves on the unrelated tile-load idle, so playback advances on top of the stale year. This is the CHARTER non-goal 3 'render-gated playhead' promise failing in exactly the case the honest-timeline work was for, introduced by the critic-requested 'style-loaded guard' must-fix in 0b6ef98 being implemented with the wrong predicate. No test covers it: the maplibre mock's isStyleLoaded is a constant and page.tsx has no unit tests. Fix shape (relay): guard on the map's `load` having fired (a ref set in CanopyMap.onLoad, or try/catch around the throw) and make the effect re-run when that flips, or simply call it inside try/catch since post-load it cannot throw.
bucket_reason: demonstrable defect in the honest-timeline contract; one-line predicate fix but needs a live QA item since the sandbox cannot render

title: T1 remediation 1c37d21 (clear stale status on toggle-off) never fires for any PUBLIC layer: the clear sits below the hasTileSource early return
evidence: src/components/map/DataLayer.tsx:1143 (`if (!map || layer.source.type !== 'wfs' || hasTileSource) return;`) precedes :1149-1152 (`if (!visible) { clearLayerStatus(layer.id); return; }`); src/lib/layers/registry.ts:882-890 (PUBLIC_LAYER_IDS: 6 data layers, all with tileSource); DataLayer.tsx:1104-1106 handlePmtilesError

All six public data layers (forest-age, old-growth-250, cutblocks, parks, fire-history, tap-priority) are tile-backed, and their ONLY status source is the PMTiles path (handlePmtilesError -> setLayerStatus(id,'error') on the 15 s header timeout or an addLayer throw). ARCHITECTURE.md §Status model ('Statuses clear on layer unmount') describes the pre-P1a world and is doc-drift on top. Fix shape: a `useEffect(() => { if (!visible) clearLayerStatus(layer.id); }, [visible])` at DataLayer level, above the source-type branching, and delete the now-redundant clear inside loadData. Test that would go red: mount DataLayer for a tileSource layer, fire onError, flip visible=false, assert layerStatuses lacks the id -- today it does not exist; the existing dual-source/loading-context tests never mount DataLayer.

title: PmtilesLayers adds its layers from a stale closure: a visibility toggle or class-filter change during the async source wait is silently lost
evidence: src/components/map/DataLayer.tsx:237-245 (effect deps exclude visible/classFilters), :290/:311/:357 (`visible` read from the effect closure inside addLayersToMap), :448-475 and :494-499 (the reactive effects bail with `if (!getLayer(fillId)) return` when layers do not exist yet); contrast SatelliteLayers :118-122 + :147-152 (visibleRef, added 42ab047 2026-06-11 for exactly this race)
detail: PmtilesLayers registers the shared source, then waits for `load` and/or `sourcedata` before calling addLayersToMap, which writes `layout.visibility` from the `visible` captured when the effect was created (mount). All DataLayers mount at once with the initial enabledLayers (CanopyMap.tsx:209-217). If the user toggles a tile-backed layer ON during the wait (basemap style load + PMTiles header fetch, seconds on mobile), the visibility effect runs but finds no layer and no-ops; when the layers are finally added they take visible=false from the closure, and nothing re-runs the effect. Result: the legend shows the layer checked, the map shows nothing, until the user toggles twice. The same applies to a class-filter change made in that window (filter effect :494 bails, addLayersToMap applies only the registry base filter). SatelliteLayers solved this identical race with `visibleRef` on 2026-06-11; PmtilesLayers never got the same treatment. Fix shape: (a) read visible/classFilters/timelineActive through refs at addLayer time, or better (b) bump a `layersReady` state counter after addLayersToMap so the two reactive effects re-run against the real layers -- (b) also fixes the filter half. Guardable with the wfs-layers-d10 harness: mount tileSource layer with visible=false and style not loaded, rerender visible=true, `map._emit('load')` then `_emit('sourcedata',{sourceId})`, assert layout visibility === 'visible'.
bucket_reason: reproducible lost-toggle defect in the public layer path; small fix but in lifecycle code, needs the rendered test and a live QA item

title: DataLayer.tsx verdict: merely long, not intrinsically costly -- the cost sits in two seams (async add-time closure, status side-effects split across three places), not in the line count
evidence: DataLayer.tsx:106-209 (SatelliteLayers, 2 effects), :218-581 (PmtilesLayers, 3 effects), :630-999 (WfsLayers, 5 effects), :1067-1391 (DataLayer container: status + WFS fetch + raster JSX); style-load guard shape identical at :173-178, :422-435, :858-863; cleanup shape identical at :180-190, :869-883
detail: Read end to end: the three sub-renderers are consistent in the ways that matter -- all gate on isStyleLoaded()/`load`, all insert before firstSymbolId, all route paint through pickDefinedPaint except two literal-only paints and the outline paint whose registry fields are all required (types/layers.ts:61-66), so invariant 2 holds. They differ deliberately: Satellite/WFS remove their own layers on cleanup, PMTiles does not (shared source, comment at :442) -- load-bearing, leave it. What makes the file expensive to change is (a) PmtilesLayers reading render-time props inside an async callback with the reactive effects unable to catch up (R1-05), while SatelliteLayers uses a ref for the same thing -- one file, two conventions; (b) status is set in DataLayer (WFS path), in PmtilesLayers via onError (tile path), and cleared in loadData behind a guard that excludes the tile path (R1-03): the dual-source rule is enforced by an early return in a fetch function, not by the status model. Fixing (a) and (b) is ~40 lines and removes most of the hazard. A file split into Satellite/Pmtiles/Wfs modules would be behaviour-identical but buys little beyond navigation and would churn the T1 blame -- decline the split, do the seams.
bucket_reason: a split/rewrite is not justified; the two concrete seams are already routed as R1-03 and R1-05

summary: The /map rendering core is structurally sound and the 2026-08-27 global-state switch is clean in DataLayer itself (no per-tick setFilter remnants, filter effect keyed on on/off + class changes, one dead eslint-disable). The important item is R1-02: the critic-requested style-loaded guard in page.tsx was implemented with `isStyleLoaded()`, which in MapLibre 5.21 is false whenever any tile is in flight, so year updates are silently dropped and never retried -- the honest-timeline promise (CHARTER non-goal 3) fails in exactly the slow-load case it was built for. Two prior-refresh remediations landed but miss the public surface: 1c37d21's stale-status clear sits below the tile-backed early return so it never runs for any public layer (R1-03), and e5c8554's health-report fix left the WFS branch reporting false errors for every enabled layer (R1-06); a third defect, the stale-closure `visible`/filter at PMTiles add time (R1-05), is the same race SatelliteLayers fixed with a ref in June. DataLayer.tsx is long but not intrinsically costly; its cost is those two seams, and PmtilesLayers -- the path every public layer uses -- has no rendered test while a working harness (d10) already exists. Verified clean: invariant 2 in all three sub-renderers (outline fields are required types), deterministic z-order (registry order + always-mount + before-firstSymbol; raster/vector zoom ranges never overlap), R2 URL SSOT (no inline r2.dev), no dolly remnants in hooks, layer-id alias compat complete on URL/localStorage/popstate with preset ids unrenamed, useTimeline's injected waitForRender/watchdog contract intact and pinned by a real test, and the deep-link/history/alias/dialog/shortcut suites are genuine revert-proven guards.
